notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Source is Shell plc's 2024 Form 20-F as filed with the SEC (filed March 25, 2025), which includes the Annual Report; Shell reports in US dollars. SAWAN: 266,533 ordinary shares at December 31, 2024. The 20-F gives no percentage; Directors and Senior Management together held less than 1% of Company shares at March 7, 2025, so pctEconomic is null. His interest rose by a further 108,275 shares by March 7, 2025, after delivery of 2024 bonus shares and vesting of the 2022 LTIP. The 476,070 unvested performance-conditioned awards are not counted. BLACKROCK: 615,032,699 shares from a Schedule 13G/A filed February 6, 2024, whose event date is December 31, 2023 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1306965/000108636424006717/gb00bp6mxd84_020624.txt). That 13G/A gave 9.4% at the time; the 20-F's 10.2% divides the same share count by the smaller March 4, 2025 share count, after buybacks, so the percentage is stale. The 20-F lists only investors with 5% or more; the Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules notification threshold is 3%, but no 3% list appears in the 20-F. DIVIDENDS exclude $295m paid to non-controlling interests. BUYBACKS exclude $789m of 'Shares held in trust: net purchases and dividends received' (employee share plan trusts). STOCK COMP is the equity-settled share-based compensation expense in Note 28 ($732m, also in the employee costs note); the cash-flow statement has no separate line.

footprint.notes: Countries come from the country-by-country reporting (CbCR) table 'Our tax data by jurisdiction' in Shell's Tax Contribution Report 2024 (94 jurisdictions; India and Saudi Arabia sit at page breaks). Tax paid is corporate income tax paid (cash-flow basis) in whole dollars in the source, converted to USD millions without rounding; '–' entries (Bermuda, Cayman Islands) are omitted. Employees are average FTEs eligible for Shell's standard terms, so they do not match the 20-F year-end headcount (96,000 incl. portfolio companies). The 20-F also gives employees by region (Africa 3, Asia 36, Europe 30, North America 23, Oceania 3, South America 2, in thousands, year-end 2024) but rounded to thousands, so not repeated. Royalties and other payments to governments (Report on Payments to Governments) are not included. Shell publishes no U.S. state breakdown; the 20-F places Shell Polymers Monaca only 'in the USA', so no state is given. Sites are from the 2024 20-F.
